Tornadoes, on the other hand, are completely different. Tornadoes are smaller, more violent, and don't necessarily have to come from a cyclone. They can come out of a storm, or in some cases, can form from a cumulonimbus cloud. Cumulonimbus clouds are the ones that have the mushroom shape. And tornadoes can form over land, and often do. text:
I have a personal take on this, which is that post-modernism is the moment when we stopped believing the whole story is true. It is not that stories are false, but that there is no way of proving one story is really the truth. And that is the same way that quantum physics says that there is no way of knowing that an atom is in one place. There are multiple ways of looking at the same thing. And there's no way of proving which is the right answer. If there was a way of proving that, then the wave would collapse to a point.

Post-modernism is just the same thing. There's no way of proving that one way of looking is correct. So in some ways it's liberating, because we can now have many truths. The truth is that there is no single truth. And this is very hard to accept. And some people hate it, because it's very easy to get muddled in it. You can have 1000 different ways of looking at the same thing.

But I like it, because it means we can create our own truth, or we can choose which truth to believe. And once we decide which truth we're going to believe, we're going to have to live with it. That's the deal. And when you look at a lot of post-modernist texts, they all have this idea of a person trying to find their own truth. And it's not that there's no truth, it's that there's no absolute truth. And that's really hard to accept. For example, I can tell you that in my truth, I'm a man. And in your truth, you are a woman. And we can agree that there's no absolute truth. So, we're living in a world of our own truth, which is very post-modern. And when I say this, people look at me like I'm crazy, like, "How can I be a man and not be a man? How can you be a woman and not be a woman?" And that's the beauty of it. You can be both and neither. And that's the whole point. And it's really hard to explain to a 5-year-old, but really, post-modernism is just a reaction to modernism. Modernism was the idea that we can create a new truth. Post-modernism says, no, you can't. And so, it's about playing with truth and playing with language. And it's a really fun time to be alive. And it's a really fun time to make art.
